title: Walker Hayes Puts On His Puppy Voice for New Song Dedicated to His Dogs: Listen
summary: The country star teams up with pet food brand Canidae Heartland to promote the bond we all have with our four-legged friends.
contentText:
All products and services featured are independently chosen by editors. However, Billboard may receive a commission on orders placed through its retail links, and the retailer may receive certain auditable data for accounting purposes.

As a married dad to six kids, Walker Hayes is well-known as a family man , but his family extends these days to his four-legged children as well.

That’s the inspiration behind the country star’s campaign with Canidae Heartland , a new pet food line that pays tribute to America’s Heartland, with “ farm-raised nutrition ” that supports dogs, American farmers and the environment.

Canidae

As part of the campaign, Hayes has penned a new song titled, “Love Is a Four-Legged Word,” which celebrates the country star’s bond with his dogs Puckett and Copper, as well as his late dog Skeeter (sample lyric: “He’s my dog and I’m his human”).

The song starts with Hayes’ point of view, before transitioning to Skeeter’s thoughts. “I like it when Walker scratches my belly, I tell him with licks and he throws sticks,” Hayes (as Skeeter) sings. “Just a couple of best buds in the heartland, lending a paw and lending a hand,” continues the chorus to the soft-plucking acoustic ditty, which is surprisingly poignant for a simple song.

WALKER HAYES-APPROVED

Canidae Heartland Dog Food

Buy Now AT WALMART

Hayes says he originally developed the country-inspired track as a theme song for an animated kids series he’s working on, called  Walker’s Woods , but he tweaked it to better fit the Canidae campaign. As the Grammy-nominated singer explains, “If you have a bond with a dog, you just get it.”

Similarly, Canidae says it’s developing dog food “built on the belief that every bowl can make a difference.” That applies in multiple ways too: the pet food brand says it uses real meat (including farm-raised chicken) plus ancient grains like barley and whole grain sorghum, with no corn, wheat or soy, and no artificial colors, flavors or preservatives. Everything is cooked in the company’s Brownwood, Texas facility and finished with live probiotics to help support doggy digestion and immune health.

The brand also uses regeneratively-farmed ingredients, to help cultivate healthy soil and grow nutrient-rich food for your pets.

But the brand also makes a difference in another way too, donating 1% of every purchase to the American Red Cross, to support “pets, people and communities in need.” The goal: to make sure U.S. towns and neighborhoods are as strong and healthy as the pets who live in them.

ORDER FOR HOME DELIVERY

Canidae Heartland Dog Food is currently available in three varieties: farm-raised chicken, Pacific salmon and countryside lamb.

Walmart sells a 10.5-pound bag of the dry dog food for $25 online , with free delivery for Walmart+ members. This is one of the top-rated dog food brands at Walmart right now, with shoppers giving Canidae Heartland an average 4.7-star rating (out of five) from hundreds of verified reviews online.

BEST FOR PUPPIES

Canidae Heartland "Puppy Recipe" Dog Food

What we like: Canidae also has a special dry food blend developed especially for puppies up to 12 months old.

Made with real chicken, plus healthy ingredients like brown rice, barley, pumpkin and fish oil, the recipe is designed to help support strength and energy, while ensuring healthy skin and a shiny coat.

You can find out more about Canidae Pet Food and shop their full selection of products at Walmart.com . And you can listen to Hayes’ “Four-Legged Word” song below.
